name: Melusine Dragonette
original_name: メリュジーヌ＝ドラゴネット
source:
Classmate and roommate of Eros. Since she is from Dragon tribe, she can breathe fire as it's normal for her kind. However, she can't control the power and it causes troubles for surrounding so she also belongs to "Soundless Club".

Magic type: Fire
